Performers
Orquestra de música antiga de l’Esmuc (early-music orchestra), Alba Roca (concertmaster and director) Documented

The source credits Cor i Orquestra for the larger production. This track is the instrumental Chaconne; the production’s choir credit does not establish singing in this dance.

[1]
Work version
Original four-part instrumental dance; sounding pitch approximately A=415 Inferred, not documented

The file identifies the Act V Chaconne. Approximate pitch is inferred by comparing its written C major ending with the recording’s prominent sustained peaks near 494–⁠495 Hz, about a semitone below modern C5. The session source does not state a tuning reference; no exact temperament or edition is claimed.
